name: F09_3
notes: Stromkirk Bloodthief. Printed: 'if an OPPONENT lost life this turn'. It is seat 0 (the Bloodthief's controller) who loses life here: seat 1's Vampire Spawn enters and 'each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life' (seat 0 18, seat 1 22). No opponent of seat 0 lost life, so at seat 0's end step no counter lands.
